title: LRC-2022-H1_V_X-59-1
description: This time-lapse captures the X-59 while at Lockheed Martin in Fort Worth, Texas. The aircraft was in Texas for structural and fuel testing and then returned to Lockheed Martin in Palmdale, California to complete assembly. The X-59’s first flight is planned for 2023.
